ex: A zootoxin is a poison made by an animal.
Snake venom is a well-known zootoxin.
This spider makes a strong zootoxin.
Scientists use one zootoxin to make a new medicine.
zootoxin.note: A science word. In everyday English people usually say "venom" or "poison."

ex: A zubr is a large wild bison from Europe.
We saw a zubr in the national park.
The zubr is the heaviest land animal in Europe.
Can we take a photo of the zubr from here?
zubr.note: Rare in English. People usually say "European bison" or "wisent."
